verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents natural-language task input in its CLI. Its SDK docs also reference a planning agent, though only as the worked example in a guide to building custom agents. There is no documentation that a plain-language feature or bug description is automatically converted into a scoped, reviewable implementation task or spec; the agent appears to act on the prompt directly. Missing for 10: a documented automatic intent-to-spec or task-scoping workflow, evidence of the scoped task artifact and its structure, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can describe a feature or bug in plain language and have it automatically turned into a scoped implementation task

citations.quote: Type natural language tasks and receive instant feedback
Using the planning agent as a concrete example, you'll learn how to design specialized agents with custom tool sets, system prompts, and configurations
